|  | Premenopausal and aged over 40: [ ] Persistent intermenstrual bleeding over 3 consecutive months not attributable to contraception, cyclical progesterone, HRT or infection |  |
|  | For Information - USS assessment of the endometrium is of little diagnostic benefit in the premenopausal patient. If concerns are raised on an USS please submit an Advice & Guidance request to the gynaecology service. |  |
|  | Postmenopausal not taking HRT: [ ] Vaginal bleeding (PMB) after 12 months amenorrhoea [ ] Suspicious Vaginal discharge |  |
|  | [ ] Endometrial thickness >4mm on ultrasound scan (attach report) |  |
|  | Unscheduled bleeding on HRT: HRT type: Continuous combined (cc) [ ] Sequential (s) [ ] Date HRT commenced: [ ] Unscheduled Vaginal bleeding > 6 months after starting/changing HRT and not able to assess ET on USS [ ] Unscheduled Vaginal bleeding with one MAJOR risk/ three MINOR risks as per BMS flow chart (see Appendix 2) [ ] Endometrial thickness of >4mm for ccHRT or >7mm for sHRT on ultrasound scan (attach report) Bleeding within 6 months of starting or changing HRT does not typically require referral, refer to flow chart In Appendix 2. |  |
|  | Tamoxifen use: [ ] Abnormal vaginal bleeding whilst taking Tamoxifen or within 12 months of stopping |  |
|  | For Information - Co-incidental findings of thickened endometrium (up to 11mm in the absence of bleeding) - does not require referral. If there are risk factors for endometrial cancer please refer for Advice and Guidance. |  |
|  | CERVICAL/VAGINAL/VULVAL CANCER- please tick applicable boxes: |  |
|  | Suspicious lesion that looks like cancer on: Cervix [ ] Vagina [ ] Suspicious vulval lump or ulceration [ ] |  |
|  | Cervical polyps: please refer on a routine pathway. |  |
|  | Nabothian follicle cyst and ectropion are normal findings and do not require referral |  |
|  | For Information - Post coital bleeding with a normal looking cervix and negative cervical screening (smear) history does not meet suspected cancer referral. Age below 35 years refer to benign gynaecology/iCash. Age above 35 years refer on a routine pathway. |  |
|  | Please submit an Advice & Guidance request for any patient who does not meet the referral criteria but in whom you still have concerns |  |
